name: midigen-bench
description: midigen-bench is a benchmark for evaluating MIDI/symbolic music generation models. It assesses models' ability to produce coherent, musically plausible MIDI sequences given prompts, typically covering tasks such as continuation and conditional generation, and provides evaluation protocols employing both automatic MIDI-similarity metrics and human judgment.
evaluation_method: human_eval and automatic MIDI-similarity metrics (e.g., note-overlap/F1)
reputation: A niche, specialized benchmark for symbolic music generation with limited but growing adoption in the music-ML community.
